summary: In the county zoning jurisdiction, a data-center site plan requires placement in the Critical Digital Infrastructure Overlay Zone and Limited Industrial or General Industrial base zoning. The 2,614-acre overlay is mapped in the Eastalco Community Growth Area. Do not infer approval of a particular parcel or applicability inside the City of Frederick.
locator: Annual Planning Report 2025, p. 8; Bill 25-09 and adopted CDI zoning map amendment
authority: Frederick County Division of Planning and Permitting
